description: Monthly QUQU target holdings and weights. allocationMonth is the month these weights are held.

2022-10.rule: Raw weight = sqrt(Market Cap) × (6-1 gross momentum / median gross momentum)^3; 20% cap
2022-10.coverageNote: Point-in-time universe; weights are normalized over constituents with recoverable historical prices. Coverage ratio is recorded for audit.
